_comment: Pinned tax-simulator-gpu version used to generate ts_output/*.out-ts.csv.gz.  Re-pin only deliberately: doing so requires regenerating all TS outputs and re-triaging.
_comment_environment: run_ts.py runs tax-simulator-gpu in the environment that uv sync --locked --no-dev makes from the uv.lock file of the pinned commit (Python 3.12 and the pinned jax version).  Only step 2 (run_ts.py) needs uv.
